# dt01: test shared passive-objective admission at the opening

Parent source `ef22c7f92ecab5fe76e3333ab7df3f8ec567ff9a`, base bot `pi_dominant-gems-01`. Candidate `bots/pi_dominant-team-01/` only. This is a dependent, separately identified experiment; parent is tested but unpromoted. Preserve IMPLEMENTATION.md history by rewriting it for this experiment with parent/delta explicit. Do not merge into champion or change platform selection.

## Evidence, rationale and limits

Parent dg01 chooses the unique positive-gem, zero-gold, all-gem_cluster group whose gems exceed all other groups combined, only during bootstrap and only when original eligibility holds. It is active on3/112 surveyed development maps. It improves the two other affected maps7/8 vs3/8 but Vault remains1/4 vs1/4, with first useful candidate capture1239, far too late. Existing max_clear90 uses full group HP divided by one actor's strength+.2focus and excludes Vault's49 passive clusters/5880HP/343gems for ALL four starting picks. Other camps together yield16gems. Task lifetime90 remains a separate bound on travel/work/commitment.

Fish's same-map baseline clear33/capture39 and Mite's capture38 establish an opening economic opportunity with different opponents. Fish buys no items before first capture. At first center clear33, its five physical actors total6120 monster damage, equal to center5880 plus earlier cleared240HP gold group. Vendetta receives final clear credit but has only2090 cumulative damage, so clear credit cannot mean solo work. This is aggregate consistency evidence for distributed work; it does not prove exact target allocation, routes or commands. Our current four-pick roster has different abilities and fewer bodies, so success is uncertain.

Hypothesis: our identical per-actor policy can choose the same publicly known passive objective early, allowing actual work to be shared, if the one-actor max_clear estimate stops vetoing that ONE objective. This is an explicit bounded coordination experiment, not a claim of an accurate team-DPS model. All ordinary danger/retreat/banking/expiry behavior stays in force; no hidden ally/enemy state or promised future damage is used. Group contention, weak combat, travel, fuel, capture sharing or enemy arrival may invalidate it. It may improve local farming while remaining worse against leaders.

## Exact delta from parent

In choose_camp, exempt ONLY `bootstrap && i == w.dominant_gem_camp` from the `clear > Config::max_clear` rejection. The cached dominant index already guarantees the unique, passive gem-only metadata contract. Preserve the exact cutoff for every other group and every non-bootstrap decision. Keep retry, blocked/risk reachability, respawn timing, budget/current-round checks, eligibility bookkeeping, preferred-loop precedence and the parent's bootstrap preference unchanged.

No new target preemption or communication. The existing new-task caller naturally makes actors choose the shared objective when eligible. Do not change max_clear value, task_limit90, loop_phase, group definition, draft, items, combat, pathfinding, enemy handling, channels or banking. Do not add future ally DPS, AoE forecasts, magic round thresholds, map names or coordinates. Do not add release logging. The implementation should be a tiny admission exception; no framework refactor.

Update inherited focused checks to establish: overlong-clear dominant passive group admitted only during bootstrap; ordinary/mixed/attacking/gold-bearing/equal-reward targets still obey original clear gate; dominant target still rejected if unreachable, cooling or respawning beyond arrival; later-phase behavior and budget deferral unchanged. Test actual selector body/helper, not a disconnected restatement. Retain the metadata strict-dominance/canonical-index checks. Report actual checks and gaps accurately.

## Frozen PC diagnosis and progression

First exact-source current-engine release build, zero candidate faults. Vault both sides vs frozen champion and C02, with original baseline AND parent dg01 receipts matched by map/seed/opponent/side. Primary mechanism: first dominant clear/capture/bank and per-actor participation, not just W/L. Require at least one candidate-owned dominant capture before round200 and at least one subsequent bank before round250 to establish early cooperative conversion; this is still far slower than leaders38–39. Require no candidate-caused VM faults. If no early conversion, diagnose actual source task/action/fuel events and reject this admission exception as insufficient; do not loosen gates afterward to rescue it.

If that mechanism succeeds, repeat the predeclared other2 positive maps against champion/C02, both sides, and3 positive maps vs frozen D1/gold_diamond, both sides. Compare with parent and original. Retain only if total wins do not fall below either parent or original in each common-opponent stage, and disclose per-map score/capture regressions. These are developmental criteria, not confidence bounds. Then80-game negative-control screen: direct>=8/16, common>=31/64,zero candidate faults; compare changed event trajectories/fuel because earlier inactive-rule code also changed outcomes.16 confirmation maps remain reserved.

No upload merely for passing these gates: a three-map structural experiment is not broad leader competitiveness. Keep source/WASM/replays; interactions with future performance or capture changes require separate tests. Implementation belongs to Pi, validation/research to PC. Leave commits to bridge.
